title: CPPS — Exhibit
description: Three sections make up the CPPS: the exhibit, the simulator, and first aid. Large touch screens with our original mini-games that teach visitors about earthquake causes, effects, and preparation tips are incorporated into the exhibit space. Additionally, we developed a platform for a fleet of tablets that are placed strategically on walls throughout the museum and are each running a variety of software. With the help of these tablets, visitors can learn more about the activity they are currently engaged in and have a more engaging learning experience. Visitors have the option to learn at their own pace and receive guidance that is specifically suited to their needs. An escape game will also assist visitors in learning as much as possible while having fun. Finishing the game should take about an hour.

title: SpinLab - La plateforme gratuite qui connecte coachs et joueurs
description: Coachs géolocalisés, réservations instantanées, paiement sécurisé, suivi d’entraînement… Tout ce dont vous avez besoin, dans une seule application

title: Mobile Games Collection
description:
A comprehensive collection of mobile games developed for Android platforms, showcasing diverse gameplay mechanics and engaging experiences.

• **Pygmak** - An addictive container-catching game where you battle endless waves of falling containers and redeem precious loot for upgrades

• **Concron** - A strategic puzzle experience that challenges your problem-solving skills

• **Scrunch** - A fun puzzle manipulation game where players solve challenges by interacting with the virtual environment

• **Endless Runner** - A fast-paced infinite running adventure with dynamic obstacles and challenges

• **Paknight** - An action-packed knight adventure featuring combat and exploration

• **Shooter Hero** - An intense shooting experience with engaging combat mechanics

• **Sibtrip** - An immersive journey game that takes players on a unique adventure

• **Zigzag** - A challenging reflex-based game that tests your timing and coordination

Each game demonstrates different aspects of mobile game development, from casual arcade mechanics to more complex gameplay systems, showcasing versatility in mobile gaming experiences.

title: Inkwell
description: Blinded, you must find clever ways to find all three keys and escape the maze with one tool: the ability to paint the walls around you. The player must come up with good spatial awareness strategies to avoid getting lost forever. This research project raises awareness of the difficulties blind people have navigating environments mainly built for the sighted.

title: Magic Arrow
description: A Java Minecraft plugin that augments bows with block-placing and other effects based on the block you're standing on.

title: Dean - The Spiritual Journey
description: A fascinating conversation with Dean, an ex-Jehovah's Witness who embarked on an extraordinary spiritual journey through many different religions. We explore his path of discovery, the various faiths he encountered along the way, and discuss the unique spiritual state he has reached today after years of searching and questioning.

title: Frank - The Elder's Perspective
description: An intimate interview with Frank, a Jehovah's Witness elder, where we discuss not only religious beliefs and practices, but also deeply personal topics including the heartbreaking reality of living next to his shunned daughter. Frank shares his journey to becoming an elder and provides insight into the complex emotional and spiritual challenges of his faith.

title: Frank Part 2 - Deeper Conversations
description: The continuation of our conversation with Frank, delving deeper into the complexities of his role as an elder, the personal cost of religious conviction, and further exploration of the difficult balance between faith and family relationships within the Jehovah's Witness community.
